project: Aayush Raj Portfolio - Awwwards-Tier Engineering Showcase Redesign

userStories.title: Ground Data & Real GitHub Repositories
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want to see 100% genuine projects with real GitHub links to Aayush-2825 repositories and accurate trade-offs so that the credibility of the engineering work is undeniable.
acceptanceCriteria: data/projects.ts includes real GitHub repo links for viewproof, pjmb, Swabhimaan-2, and blog
No unverified TODO placeholders in user-facing project summaries
Technical decisions and trade-offs are grounded in real architectural reasoning
Typecheck and build pass
userStories.notes: Verified genuine GitHub repo links added, zero unverified TODO placeholders, next build passed.

userStories.title: Awwwards-Grade Spring-Driven Cursor & Magnetic Micro-Interactions
userStories.description: As a desktop user, I want a smooth, physics-based target cursor that magnetically snaps and morphs with action hints over interactive elements so that the interface feels alive and tactile.
acceptanceCriteria: Target cursor follows mouse with smooth spring physics
Cursor morphs to display contextual action pills ('EXPLORE', 'VIEW', 'COPY', 'TERMINAL') on hover
Gracefully disables on touch/mobile devices and under prefers-reduced-motion
Typecheck and build pass
userStories.notes: TargetCursorFallback mounted in PortfolioShell with spring physics, contextual hover action pills, and useSyncExternalStore.
